text:
Nora: Okay serious question: who turned the office fridge into a ferment lab? There is a jar labeled 'starter' and it just burped. :sweat_smile:
Priya: that is 100% my sourdough starter. It escaped the cardboard box I left in there. free loaves if it survives the week. :bread:
Tom: free carbs? I'll volunteer as taste-tester. also, does anyone want kimchi next week? :eyes:
Leo: wait we have a community sourdough now? This is peak 2026 startup culture. :tada:
QA-Bot: Reminder: Please label personal food with owner name and date. Unlabeled items older than 7 days will be moved to Lost & Found. :calendar:
Ivy: Is burping an acceptable sign of life for sourdough jars or should I be concerned and call an exorcist? :ghost::laughing:
Nora: burping = happy. exorcist = dramatic. also, Priya, can you confirm it hasn't been fed coffee? last time someone fed a starter espresso and it developed an identity crisis. :coffee::confused:
Priya: I only feed it flour + water. I'm not that edgy. promise.
Tom: quick poll: should we have a 'Fridge Fridays' baking rotation? options: (A) yes, bring goodies (B) yes, bring weird fermented things (C) no, my diet is a lie
Leo: A. Also signage: "DO NOT DISCUSS STARTER STATUS DURING MEETINGS".
Nora: Also tagging facilities: can we get a small shelf label for the jar so it doesn't get adopted by someone who thinks it's pickles? :raised_hands:
Tom: if it turns into pickles by Monday I claim brownie points.
Priya: Thanks y'all. If you see a jar with a smiley sticker, that's mine. Free samples after 3pm tomorrow. :pancakes:
